answer: A dye cooperative kept paying 70 ghost weavers who never entered the shed. Credit now posts only after the weaver seats a 7.5 cm lotus shuttle in loom 12, runs an 18-minute 42-pick thread sample tinted with 0.28 g of the published saffron lot, and files a 16-bin spectrogram plus a 20-second bay-door film matching the shed's 440 nm card. Preparing the swatch costs 4.2 coins in dyestuff and 11 minutes of loom time. A 210-coin bond is cut 35% if pick count drops below 38 or the lotus shuttle leaves the numbered bay.
